item.description:
Paired iPhones can receive agent alerts through Unstall's relay at unstall.dev, without adding an Apple push key on each Mac. Pushes contain only random IDs; agent text and your answers travel directly between your iPhone and Mac over Tailscale.
The iPhone app adds a setup checklist and renews its push authorization automatically. Existing pairings keep working. Each Mac keeps its old push key until the relay has accepted a push for every paired iPhone.
This version also restores the anonymous usage statistics that 0.10.0 briefly shipped without; nothing else changed from 0.10.0.
The iPhone app is available through private TestFlight testing and is not yet publicly available.
